encoding_notes: BLOCKED SOURCE: live guide behind Radware 'Client Challenge' (bot shell); Apify headless render returned only the challenge; no Wayback snapshot exists for this URL; Jina proxy 401. OMITTED types with no clean enum slot: 'Perspective' (invited opinion/commentary, unsolicited not accepted) and 'Report' (short brief report) — noted here rather than force-mapped.

ISSN 1432-0827 (online) confirmed via ISSN Portal; 0171-967X (print) via search. Publisher Springer (Springer US / Springer Nature); hybrid open-access journal.
Springer standard 'Text' boilerplate surfaced in search ('normal, plain font, e.g., 10-point Times Roman') is an EXAMPLE not a mandate -> layout.font left null.
Submission system almost certainly Editorial Manager (Springer default) but NOT verified from the blocked guide -> submission_system null.

Guide section headings reported by search (standard Springer template): Types of Papers, Manuscript Submission, Title Page, Text, Scientific style, References, Tables, Artwork and Illustrations Guidelines, Supplementary Information — individual values inside these sections were unreadable.

Enum-typed fields lacking a null option (references.style, references.order, tables.placement/numbering, figures.legends_location) were set null/neutral because the guide was unreadable; references.style set to 'custom' as the least-committal enum value (actual style unverified — Springer/CTI is likely a numbered bracket style but this was NOT confirmed from the guide). layout.line_numbers left 'none' as conservative default (not verified).
All blinding flags false: no evidence CTI uses double-blind/anonymized review (Springer default is single-blind); unverified.
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'bracket' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'custom').
[schema-required default] references.journal_abbrev defaulted to 'nlm' (guide silent; NLM/Index Medicus abbreviations assumed).
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.

2026-07-25 Janine re-encode from the PRIMARY guide (link.springer.com/journal/223/submission-guidelines), clearing this file's low_confidence_reencode flag. The Springer journal page is reachable even though the publisher's other surfaces are not. Guide states: Original Articles "5,000 words, 45 references, no more than 8 figures/tables"; Reviews "10,000 words, 100 references, no more than 10 figures"; Letters to Editor "500 words"; Editorials "1,000 words and a maximum of 1 figure / table" (invitation only). Abstract "150 to 250 words" -> max 250; abstract.structured left false (the guide sets a length, not a required section structure). COMBINED figure+table caps (8 for originals, 1 for editorials) cannot be expressed as separate figures_max/tables_max -> both left null; Reviews' cap is figures-ONLY ("no more than 10 figures") so figures_max=10 is exact. OMITTED for lack of a schema enum slot: "Reports" (1,500 words / 20 refs / 3 figures-tables) and "Perspectives" (2,500 words / 3 figure-tables, unsolicited not accepted). Case reports are NOT listed as an accepted type.

2026-07-25 Janine: references.et_al_threshold deliberately LEFT NULL despite the guide naming a number. The guide states: "the names of all authors should be provided. For references with more than 7 authors the usage of 'et al' after the first 7 authors have been named will also be accepted." That 7 is a PERMISSION, not an instruction - the guide's primary instruction is to provide all authors. Encoding 7 would truncate lists the journal actually prefers in full; style is 'custom', so null renders every author, which satisfies the primary instruction and never raises a flag against an author who used et al. Same family as aots / european-spine-journal / kssta (Session 98). Do not 'fix' this to 7.
